<a id="page-themes"></a>

## About this page

Every theme WM Pass comes with, and the ones you made or imported. Click one to use it.

#### How it works

A theme is a small file: colors for its light side, colors for its dark side, a corner size and a font. Each theme in the list shows its colors and says whether it has a light side, a dark side or both.

The built-in themes are WM Pass, High contrast, Catppuccin, Catppuccin Frappé, Catppuccin Macchiato, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, One, Rosé Pine, Rosé Pine Moon, Everforest, Ayu, Ayu Mirage, Kanagawa, Monokai and GitHub. Apart from WM Pass and High contrast, each uses its project's published palette.

The menu beside each theme edits it or makes a copy to customize, shares it, or deletes one of yours.

The phone and the computer read the same theme files, so a theme shared from one opens on the other.

#### Limits

Every theme, built-in or not, has its text checked against its background. Text too faint to read is darkened or lightened until it is readable.

#### On Android

Device colors, every theme WM Pass comes with, and the ones you made or imported. Tap one to use it.

See also [Themes and colors](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-themes), [Dark mode](/guide/settings/look/#setting-look), [New theme](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-new), [Import](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-import), [Share…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-share).

<a id="action-theme-device"></a>

## Device colors

*Only in Android.*

Takes the app's colors from your wallpaper.

#### How it works

It is offered on Android 12 and later.

#### Limits

With the Glass style, the accent you pick under Style and theme is used instead.

See also [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/), [Accent](/guide/settings/look/#setting-accent).

<a id="group-themes-yours"></a>

## Yours

Themes you made or imported. The built-in ones are listed below them.

#### How it works

They are kept in this device's settings, outside the vault. A [settings file](/guide/settings/file/) carries them to another device, and each theme in it goes through the same checks as an import.

**Reset all customization** keeps your own themes.

#### Limits

A theme in a settings file you import replaces one of yours with the same name.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/), [Share…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-share).

<a id="action-theme-new"></a>

## New theme

Opens the theme editor on a copy of the WM Pass theme, for you to make your own.

#### How it works

Give it a name, then choose **Light** or **Dark** for the side you are coloring. The preview at the top shows a row, a password and a few buttons in your colors as you go.

There are eleven colors: the accent, the background, three levels of surface, three of text, and danger, warning and information. Beside each is its contrast against the background.

**Corners** goes from square to 28 px. **Font** is System, Inter, Serif or Mono.

**Save and use** adds it under Yours and switches to it.

#### Limits

Changing the accent resets the colors worked out from it, such as the tint behind selected things, so they follow the new one.

Text that falls under a readable contrast with its background is darkened or lightened when the theme is drawn, so a faint color may come out stronger than you picked.

#### On Android

Give it a name, then choose **Light** or **Dark** for the side you are coloring. The preview at the top shows a row, a password and a few buttons in your colors as you go.

There are eleven colors: the accent, the background, three levels of surface, three of text, and danger, warning and information. Tap one to set it with **Hue**, **Saturation** and **Brightness**, or type a #RRGGBB code. Its contrast against the background is shown as you go.

**Corners** goes from square to 28 dp. **Font** is System, Inter, Serif, Mono, or a .ttf or .otf file you add with **Add a font file**, which is kept inside the app. The font buttons and the sample line under them are drawn in each font.

**Save and use** adds it under Yours and switches to it.

Changing the accent resets the colors worked out from it, such as the tint behind selected things, so they follow the new one.

Text that falls under a readable contrast with its background is darkened or lightened when the theme is drawn, so a faint color may come out stronger than you picked.

The Glass style keeps its own type and shapes, so corners and font show only with the Standard style.

See also [Edit…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-edit), [Customize a copy…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-copy), [Share…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-share).

<a id="action-theme-import"></a>

## Import

Adds a theme from a code someone shared, or from a .wmtheme file, and switches to it.

#### How it works

Paste a code that starts with wmpass-theme: and click **Import**, or click **Choose a file**.

#### Limits

A theme from outside is treated as a stranger's data:

- It gets a new id, so it can never replace a theme you already have.
- Its name loses any control characters and is cut to 40 characters.
- Every color has to be a plain #RRGGBB value, or the theme is refused.
- Corners are held between 0 and 28, and a font other than System, Inter, Serif or Mono becomes System.
- Text too faint to read against its background is made readable.
- Anything over 8 KB, or made for a newer version of WM Pass, is refused.

A theme can change only colors, corners and the font. It carries no other setting and nothing from a vault.

#### On Android

Paste a code that starts with wmpass-theme: and tap **Import**, **Scan** a theme's QR code, or pick a **File**.

See also [Share…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-share), [Yours](/guide/settings/themes/#group-themes-yours).

<a id="action-theme-edit"></a>

## Edit…

Opens one of your themes in the theme editor. Saving changes it in place.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Edit.

See also [New theme](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-new), [Customize a copy…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-copy).

<a id="action-theme-copy"></a>

## Customize a copy…

Opens a built-in theme in the editor as a new theme of your own, named after it with "copy" on the end. The built-in one stays as it was.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Customize a copy.

See also [New theme](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-new), [Edit…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-edit).

<a id="action-theme-share"></a>

## Share…

Shows a theme as a QR code and a code you can copy, or saves it as a .wmtheme file.

#### How it works

The code starts with wmpass-theme: and holds the whole theme, so it can go in a message. Paste it into **Import** on another device, or scan the QR code with the phone.

A theme holds colors, a corner size and a font. Nothing from your vault is in it.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Share.

The sheet shows a QR code when the theme is small enough for one, and offers **Send to an app**, **Copy** and **Save as a file**. The code starts with wmpass-theme: and holds the whole theme.

A theme holds colors, a corner size and a font. Nothing from your vault is in it.

See also [Import](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-import), [Yours](/guide/settings/themes/#group-themes-yours).

<a id="action-theme-delete"></a>

## Delete

Removes one of your themes from this device. If it was in use, WM Pass goes back to its default theme.

#### Limits

Built-in themes cannot be deleted. Share a theme first if you might want it again.

See also [Yours](/guide/settings/themes/#group-themes-yours), [Share…](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-share).
